H100.def: from the same as «098»; a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication a rush (as growing there); collectively a rope of rushes:--bulrush, caldron, hook, rush.

H101.def: probably from «05059»; a bowl (as pounded out hollow):--basin, cup, goblet.

H102.et: probably from (05062) (through the idea of impending)
H102.def: probably from «05062» (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e. (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops:--bands.

H104.def: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman):--letter.

H106.def: from «01640» (in the sense of grasping); the clenched hand:--fist.

H108.def: from the same as «0181» (in the sense of enveloping); a fog:-- mist, vapor.

H110.et: probably from (0109) (in the sense of chastisement) and (0410)
H110.def: probably from «0109» (in the sense of chastisement) and «0410»; disciplined of God; Adbeel, a son of Ishmael:--Adbeel.

H111.def: probably an orthographical variation for «02301»; Adad (or Hadad), an Edomite:--Hadad.

H112.def: of uncertain derivation; Iddo, an Israelite:--Iddo.

H113.et: from an unused root (meaning to rule)
H113.def: or (shortened) adon {aw-done'}; from an unused root (meaning to rule); sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine):-- lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with "Adoni-".

H114.def: probably intensive for «0113»; powerful; Addon, apparently an Israelite:--Addon.

H115.et: dual from (0142) (in the sense of eminence)
H115.def: dual from «0142» (in the sense of eminence); double mound; Adorajim, a place in Palestine:--Adoraim.

H116.def: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; then (of time):--now, that time, then.

H117.def: from «0142»; wide or (generally) large; figuratively, powerful:--excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(- ier one), noble, principal, worthy.

H118.def: of Persian derivation; Adalja, a son of Haman:--Adalia.

H119.def: to show blood (in the face), i.e. flush or turn rosy:--be (dyed, made) red (ruddy).

H120.def: from «0119»; ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.):--X another, + hypocrite, + common sort, × low, man (mean, of low degree), person.

H121.def: the same as «0120»; Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine:--Adam.

H123.def: or (fully) oEdowm {ed-ome'}; from «0122»; red (see Gen. 25:25); Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him:--Edom, Edomites, Idumea.

H124.def: from «0119»; redness, i.e. the ruby, garnet, or some other red gem:--sardius.

H126.def: contracted for «0127»; earthy; Admah, a place near the Dead Sea:--Admah.

H127.def: from «0119»; soil (from its general redness):--country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land.

H128.def: the same as «0127»; Adamah, a place in Palestine:--Adamah.

H129.def: from «0127»; earthy; Adami, a place in Palestine:--Adami.

H130.def: or (fully) aEdowmiy {ed-o-mee'}; patronymic from «0123»; an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom:--Edomite. See «0726».

H131.def: plural of «0121»; red spots; Adummim, a pass in Palestine:--Adummim.

H132.def: or (fully) admowniy {ad-mo-nee'}; from «0119»; reddish (of the hair or the complexion):--red, ruddy.

H133.def: probably of Persian derivation: Admatha, a Persian nobleman:--Admatha.

H134.et: from the same as (0113) (in the sense of strength)
H134.def: from the same as «0113» (in the sense of strength); a basis (of a building, a column, etc.):--foundation, socket.

H135.def: intensive from the same as «0134»; firm; Addan, an Israelite:--Addan.

H136.def: am emphatic form of «0113»; the Lord (used as a proper name of God only):--(my) Lord.

H137.def: from «0113» and «0966»; lord of Bezek; Adoni-Bezek; a Canaanitish king:--Adoni-bezek.

H138.def: original (prolonged) dAdoniyahuw {ad-o-nee- yaw'-hoo}; from «0113» and «03050»; lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Adonijah, the name of three Israelites:--Adonijah.

H139.def: from «0113» and «06664»; lord of justice; Adoni-Tsedek, a Canaanitish king:--Adonizedec.

H140.def: from «0113» and «06965»; lord of rising (i.e. high); Adonikam, the name of one or two Israelites:--Adonikam.

H141.def: from «0113» and «07311»; lord of height; Adoniram, an Israelite:--Adoniram.

H142.def: a primitive root; to expand, i.e. be great or (figuratively) magnificent:--(become) glorious, honourable.

H143.def: probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire; Adar, the 12th Hebrew month:--Adar.

H145.def: from «0142»; amplitude, i.e. (concrete) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor:--goodly, robe.

H146.def: intensive from «0142»; ample; Addar, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite:--Addar.

H147.et: intensive, from a root corresponding to (0142)
H147.def: (Aramaic) intensive, from a root corresponding to «0142»; ample, i.e. a threshing-floor:--threshingfloor.

H148.def: (Aramaic) from the same as «0147», and «01505»; a chief diviner, or astrologer:--judge.

H149.def: (Aramaic) probably of Persian origin; quickly or carefully:--diligently.

H150.def: of Persian origin; a daric or Persian coin:--dram.

H151.def: contracted for «0141»; Adoram (or Adoniram), an Israelite:--Adoram.

H152.def: from «0142» and «04428»; splendor of (the) king; Adrammelek, the name of an Assyrian idol, also of a son of Sennacherib:--Adrammelech.

H153.def: (Aramaic) an orthographical variation for «01872»; an arm, i.e. (figuratively) power:--force.

H154.def: from the equivalent of «0153»; mighty; Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine:--Edrei.

H155.def: feminine of «0117»; something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress); also the same as «0145»:--garment, glory, goodly, mantle, robe.

H156.def: a primitive root; to tread out (grain):--thresh.

H157.def: or raheb {aw-habe'}; a primitive root; to have affection for (sexually or otherwise):--(be-)love(-d, -ly, -r), like, friend.

H158.def: from «0157»; affection (in a good or a bad sense):--love(-r).

H160.def: feminine of «0158» and meaning the same:--love.

H161.et: from an unused root meaning to be united
H161.def: from an unused root meaning to be united; unity; Ohad, an Israelite:--Ohad.

H162.et: apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily, Oh!
H162.def: apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily; Oh!:--ah, alas.

H163.def: probably of foreign origin; Ahava, a river of Babylonia:--Ahava.

H164.def: from the same as «0161»; united; Ehud, the name of two or three Israelites:--Ehud.

H165.def: apparently an orthographical variation for «0346»; where:--I will be (Hos. 13:10, 14) (which is often the rendering of the same Hebrew form from «01961»).

H166.def: a primitive root; to be clear:--shine.

H167.def: a denominative from «0168»; to tent:--pitch (remove) a tent.

H168.def: from «0166»; a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance):--covering, (dwelling)(place), home, tabernacle, tent.

H169.def: the same as «0168»; Ohel, an Israelite:--Ohel.

H170.et: in form a f of (0168), but in fact for 'Oholahh {o-hol-aw'}
H170.def: in form a feminine of «0168», but in fact for .Oholahh {o-hol-aw'}; from «0168»; her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary); Oholah, a symbol. name for Samaria:--Aholah.

H171.def: from «0168» and «01»; tent of (his) father; Oholiab, an Israelite:--Aholiab.

H172.def: (similarly with «0170») for hOholiybahh {o''-hol-e-baw'}; from «0168»; my tent (is) in her; Oholibah, a symbolic name for Judah:--Aholibah.

H173.def: from «0168» and «01116»; tent of (the) height; Oholibamah, a wife of Esau:--Aholibamah.

H174.def: or (feminine) ahalowth {a-haw-loth'} (only used thus in the plural); of foreign origin; aloe wood (i.e. sticks):--(tree of lign-) aloes.

H175.def: of uncertain derivation; Aharon, the brother of Moses:--Aaron.

H176.et: presumed to be the "constructive" or genitival form of 'av {av}; short for (185)
H176.def: presumed to be the "constructive" or genitival form of -av {av}; short for «0185»; desire (and so probably in Prov. 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if:--also, and, either, if, at the least, × nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.

H177.def: from «0176» and «0410»; wish of God; Uel, and Israelite:--Uel.

H178.et: from the same as (01) (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name)
H178.def: from the same as «01» (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name); properly, a mumble, i.e. a water skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar):--bottle, familiar spirit.

H179.def: probably from «056»; mournful; Obil, an Ishmaelite:--Obil.

H180.def: or (shortened) ubal {oo-bawl'}; from «02986» (in the sense of «02988»); a stream:--river.

H181.et: from an unused root meaning to rake together
H181.def: from an unused root meaning to rake together; a poker (for turning or gathering embers):--(fire-)brand.

H182.def: or (shortened) rodowth {o-doth'} (only thus in the plural); from the same as «0181»; turnings (i.e. occasions); (adverb) on account of:--(be-)cause, concerning, sake.

H183.def: a primitive root; to wish for:--covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after).

H184.def: a primitive root; to extend or mark out:--point out.

H186.def: perhaps by permutation for «05813», strong; Uzai, an Israelite:--Uzai.

H187.def: of uncertain derivation; Uzal, a son of Joktan:--Uzal.

H188.et: probably from (0183) (in the sense of crying out after)
H188.def: probably from «0183» (in the sense of crying out after); lamentation; also interjectionally Oh!:--alas, woe.

H189.def: probably from «0183»; desirous; Evi, a Midianitish chief:--Evi.

H191.et: from an unused root (meaning to be perverse)
H191.def: from an unused root (meaning to be perverse); (figuratively) silly:--fool(-ish) (man).

H192.et: of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodach
H192.def: of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodak; Evil-Merodak, a Babylonian king:--Evil-merodach.

H193.et: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong
H193.def: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong; the body (as being rolled together); also powerful:--mighty, strength.

H194.def: or (shortened) rulay {oo-lah'ee}; from «0176»; if not; hence perhaps:--if so be, may be, peradventure, unless.

H195.def: of Persian derivation; the Ulai (or Eulaeus), a river of Persia:--Ulai.

H197.def: or (shortened) ,ulam {oo-lawm'}; from «0481» (in the sense of tying); a vestibule (as bound to the building):--porch.

H198.et: apparently from (0481) (in the sense of dumbness)
H198.def: appar, from «0481» (in the sense of dumbness); solitary; Ulam, the name of two Israelites:--Ulam.

H199.def: apparently a variation of «0194»; however or on the contrary:--as for, but, howbeit, in very deed, surely, truly, wherefore.
